gloss: hot and humid; high temperature and high humidity

definitions.gloss: hot and humid; high temperature and high humidity
definitions.explanation: Describes weather or climate conditions characterized by both high temperatures and high humidity levels.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{夏|なつ}は{高温多湿|こうおんたしつ}だ。
examples.english: Japanese summers are hot and humid.

examples.japanese: {高温多湿|こうおんたしつ}の{環境|かんきょう}ではカビが{生|は}えやすい。
examples.english: Mold grows easily in hot and humid environments.

examples.japanese: {高温多湿|こうおんたしつ}の{場所|ばしょ}を{避|さ}けて{保管|ほかん}してください。
examples.english: Please store in a place away from high heat and humidity.

examples.japanese: {高温多湿|こうおんたしつ}な{気候|きこう}のせいで、{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}に{注意|ちゅうい}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Because of the hot and humid climate, it's necessary to watch out for heatstroke.

notes:
A four-character compound: {高温|こうおん} (high temperature) + {多湿|たしつ} (high humidity). Extremely common when describing Japan's summer climate and frequently seen on product labels, weather forecasts, and storage instructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高温多湿|こうおんたしつ}の{環境|かんきょう} — hot and humid environment
- {高温多湿|こうおんたしつ}な{気候|きこう} — hot and humid climate
- {高温多湿|こうおんたしつ}を{避|さ}ける — to avoid heat and humidity
- {高温多湿|こうおんたしつ}の{場所|ばしょ} — hot and humid location

USAGE:
Very commonly seen on food packaging and product labels as a storage warning: {高温多湿|こうおんたしつ}を{避|さ}けて{保存|ほぞん}してください (store away from heat and humidity). Functions as a noun but can modify nouns with の or な.

RELATED WORDS:
- {高温|こうおん} — high temperature
- {多湿|たしつ} — high humidity
- {蒸|む}し{暑|あつ}い — muggy, sultry (describes the feeling rather than the condition)
- {低温乾燥|ていおんかんそう} — low temperature and dry (the opposite condition)
